bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
stage=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$cid" >/dev/null
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/var/lib/videobot/sticker-entry"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_DB_USER=//p' | head -n 1)"
export VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL=//p' | head -n 1)"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK=gserver-db
test -f "$VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE" || exit 51
test -f "$VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE" || exit 52
test -d "$VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE" || exit 53
test -n "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER" || exit 54
docker network inspect "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK" >/dev/null || exit 55
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$stage/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" config --quiet || exit 56
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_COMPOSE_CONFIG_WITH_EXISTING_MOUNTS=PASS\n'
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_EXISTING_SINGLE_CONTAINER_COUNT=%s\n' "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)"
